evidence: The density of the nanocrystalline Ge2Sb2Te5 (GST225) films was 6.2 g ·cm−3, similar to the density of the bulk crystalline material. The 130 °C-grown films formed a hexagonal lattice, where the basal plane was highly aligned along the substrate surface, after the postannealing at 350 °C, without the involvement of any adverse phase.
